# Support Me

If you find the downloader helpful, I'd greatly appreciate your support and donations (*╹▽╹*)!

### Patreon

[https://www.patreon.com/xuejianxianzun](https://www.patreon.com/c/xuejianxianzun)

It requires bypassing the Great Firewall, and it does not support WeChat Pay or Alipay, so it is suitable for users outside China. Of course, if you can pay through Patreon, that's totally fine too ~

### Leave a Positive Review

If you like this downloader, you can rate and review it on the installation pages:

- Rate on [Chrome Web Store](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/powerful-pixiv-downloader/dkndmhgdcmjdmkdonmbgjpijejdcilfh) (requires a Google account login).
- Rate on [Add-Ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/powerfulpixivdownloader/) (requires a Firefox account login).

Additionally, you're welcome to star this project and recommend it to friends who might need it! [Github](https://github.com/xuejianxianzun/PixivBatchDownloader ':target=_blank')
